config._note: leave-verzuim-mvp (2026-07-12): drives the EXISTING LeaveRequest lifecycle from portal-schemas (submit -> approve/reject, guarded server-side by NoSelfApprovalGuard) -- nothing on the schema changes here, only its UI. TimesheetDetail pattern: the data widget is SPLIT into 'Request' (leaveType/startDate/endDate/hours/reason -- what is being requested) and 'Approval' (status/submittedAt/approvedBy/approvedAt/rejectionReason -- the workflow trail), both excluding employeeId since Related already resolves and links the requesting Employee by name. Files sits full-width below for supporting documents (e.g. a bijzonder-verlof invitation). NO stat KPI tile: unlike Timesheet's hours-sum or Expense's amount-sum, a leave request has no single numeric headline worth a dedicated stat (hours is optional and nullable). lifecycleActions expose exactly submit/approve/reject -- no invented cancel/withdraw edge (PayrollRunDetail _note precedent: never claim a transition the backend does not guard). Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: Buy/sell leave
params.note: leave-buy-sell (2026-07-15): the IKB-style buy/sell request (ADR-001 Rule 6 — reached from EmployeeDetail's emp-leave-transactions row, MijnVerlofKopenVerkopen, or the deepLink; deliberately NOT a menu child, the CompAdjustmentDetail/PerformanceReviewDetail/TimesheetDetail convention). The 'Transactie' data widget carries transactionType/year/leaveType/hours/hourlyRate/settledAmount/settlementPeriod/status/rejectionReason/settledAt, excluding employeeId/settlementPayrollRunId (Related resolves and links both by name). lifecycleActions expose ONLY submit/approve/reject (hr-leave.json) — approve is guarded server-side by LeaveBuySellApprovalGuard (delegates to the reused NoSelfApprovalGuard, then for a sell denies unless the referenced LeaveBalance has sufficient bovenwettelijkHours); reject is guarded by NoSelfApprovalGuard directly. settle is deliberately NOT exposed as a plain lifecycleActions button: the balance write (LeaveBalance.bovenwettelijkHours -- never entitledHours/usedHours) lives inside LeaveBuySellSettlementService, and LeaveSettlementPeriodGuard alone is read-only, so a bare declarative transition would flip status to settled without ever adjusting the balance (the CompAdjustmentDetail orphaned-capability trap, verbatim) — the ONLY settle path is the guarded 'Verrekenen' api-call action (POST /api/leave/settle, LeaveController::settle). Audit history is a sidebar tab.
